text: Travel experiences can be exciting and life-changing. When planning a trip, it is important to research your destination, book tickets early, and make a simple budget. Travelling abroad lets you experience new cultures, from local festivals to traditional music. Trying local food is often the best part of any journey, and street markets are a great place to start. However, language barriers can sometimes cause problems, so learning a few basic phrases is very helpful. Despite small difficulties, travel creates unforgettable memories that stay with you forever.
